stories.title: Indian bond yields rise above 7.45% as oil hits $112.50 and RBI rate‑hike concerns grow
stories.summary: On Thursday, benchmark Indian government bond yields rose above 7.45% as crude oil prices climbed to $112.50 per barrel in Asian trading amid geopolitical tensions. The Reserve Bank of India had recently lifted its repo rate to 5.50%, fueling expectations of further tightening. Inflation concerns grew, with forecasts that retail inflation could exceed the central bank’s tolerance band.

stories.title: RBI focuses on interest‑rate gap with G7 amid inflation concerns, YES Bank sees 50 bps hike
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India says its monetary policy is now shaped by the interest‑rate gap with major developed economies and by rising inflation and input‑cost pressures. Recent GDP data show resilience, supported by strong private consumption and exports. YES Bank predicts a cumulative 50‑basis‑point rate hike.

stories.title: RBI raises repo rate by 25 basis points as inflation risks widen
stories.summary: The RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee increased the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation concerns. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said inflation is broadening, with many commodities above 4%, and Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta noted external supply‑side shocks adding to price pressures. External members warned that an aggressive hike could dampen economic growth.

stories.title: India-EU trade deal could become operational in early-2027, Piyush Goyal says
stories.summary: India's trade minister Piyush Goyal announced that the EU FTA is expected to be signed soon. The deal aims to boost market access and bilateral trade between India and the EU significantly.
